title: ActionGraph
subtitle: From meeting text to reviewable commitments.
left:
Python 3.12 + FastAPI

Optional local Ollama
Human review + SQLite
right:
Actual local HTTP execution
Synthetic meeting text
Captioned result replay

caption: Traceable proposals. Explicit review. Original evidence preserved.

title: A workflow built around review
subtitle: Extraction is a proposal, not a correctness guarantee.
left:
Transcript
  → validate input
  → rules or Ollama
  → check source evidence
  → proposed items
  → human review
right:
POST /sessions
  → server-generated proposals
  → stable IDs + revision 1
PUT /sessions/{id}/review
  → check expected revision
  → atomic save in SQLite
caption: Model failures remain failures. There is no silent rules fallback.

title: 1. Create a saved session
subtitle: One explicit promise becomes a proposal requiring review.
left:
Transcript value:

Maya: I will review the report tomorrow.
caption: The server generated and saved the proposal. Storage was explicitly enabled.

title: 2. Inspect the source
subtitle: The deadline stays “tomorrow”; no calendar date is invented.
left:
Maya: I will review the report tomorrow.

Owner: Maya
Deadline: tomorrow
right:
{
  "action": "Review the report",
  "owner": "Maya",
  "deadline": "tomorrow",
  "evidence": "Maya: I will review the report tomorrow.",
  "review_status": "needs_review"
}
caption: An exact quote proves presence. It does not prove task interpretation.

title: 3. Resolve an accepted request
subtitle: The request names the work; the next line accepts it.
left:
Omar: Maya, could you export
the attendance list by Friday?

Maya: Yes, I will export it.
caption: Evidence in the full response includes both original lines.

title: 4. Confirm without rewriting history
subtitle: Original proposal and reviewed copy remain separate.
caption: Confirmed records the caller’s decision, not completion of the task.

title: 5. Protect newer decisions
subtitle: Repeating revision 1 cannot overwrite saved revision 2.
caption: A write transaction checks revision and saves the whole batch atomically.

title: 6. Restart, then retrieve
subtitle: A new Uvicorn process reads the same disposable SQLite database.
right:
HTTP 200
revision: 2
original: needs_review
reviewed: confirmed
persisted: true

Full response unchanged
caption: The script compared the complete saved response before and after restart.

title: 7. Reject invalid input
subtitle: Whitespace is not a meeting transcript.
caption: Other boundaries include a 2 MiB request cap and 1 MiB model-envelope cap.

title: 8. Show a real limitation
subtitle: Ownerless agreed work is outside the current rules grammar.
left:
Decision: The access roster
will be updated. No owner or
date was assigned.
caption: This is a missed task. Empty output does not prove there is no work.

title: 9. Keep evaluation claims honest
subtitle: Passing tests and exact quotes do not establish semantic accuracy.
left:

right:

Not independent validation.
caption: 346 tests and CI verify implementation behavior; broader quality is not established.
